description.p: Jollyboat is a desktop app for Sharkord, the self-hosted chat with voice, video and screen sharing. Add the address of your server and use it like any other app, with a tray icon, global hotkeys and screen shares that include sound.

ul.li: Screen sharing with sound: everything you hear except your own call
Global hotkeys for mute, deafen and push-to-talk, also on Wayland
An optional voice overlay that shows who is talking, clicks go through it
A tray icon that shows when you are in a call, talking, muted or deafened, and new messages
Several servers, proxy logins (basic auth), staying logged in and share codes
Themes: Sharkord's own look, Jollyboat's lcd look, Water, or your own CSS, light or dark
Asks before a reload or quit would drop you out of a call
Talks only to your servers, no telemetry

description.p: You need a Sharkord server to connect to. Jollyboat is not affiliated with the Sharkord project.

description.p: Water theme: the Jollyboat title in the setup window shows properly in the pink and black-and-white colours (it was covered by a white block).

Theme colours: themes keep their look and come in a few colours, picked with little colour squares beside the theme menu. Water comes in blue, pink, or black and white (white by day, black by night); Retro in pink, green, or the classic grey with navy title bars. Retro pink and Retro green are one theme again (settings with Retro green carry over). The panels of the setup window no longer shift about while idle.

Saving pictures and files without another browser, which doesn't have a server's proxy login: a save button next to "open in new tab" under pictures and videos, on file cards and in the full-screen picture, and a right-click menu on the page (save or copy an image, save or copy a link, cut, copy, paste, spelling suggestions). On a server behind a proxy login, opening one of its files saves it instead of handing it to the browser. Screen sharing on Windows: windows whose preview can't be captured are still offered, and the diagnostics say what the picker found.

Two new themes, Retro pink and Retro green: a nineties desktop in pink, or in mint and sky blue. The sidebars, the chat and the member list are windows with gradient title bars on a pastel desktop (deep purple or deep teal at night), with bevelled buttons, sunken fields, old scrollbars and pixel type; the app's own windows, the overlay and the tray icon match. The theme is now picked from a drop-down menu. The voice overlay is see-through around its card again. Water theme: Sharkord's buttons that are switched on (camera, screen share) fill with water, and muted or deafened ones with red water.

Sharing a server behind a proxy login: a share code without the proxy password now leads straight to the field for it (on import, on open, and when the proxy refuses the login) instead of only failing, and sharing says whether the proxy password went along ("include proxy password").

Windows: automatic updates work again. The updater of every installed copy since 0.3.1 failed to load ("update check failed | cannot set properties of undefined"), so those copies need this version installed by hand once; from here on they update themselves.

Water theme: the voice channel you are in is a pill of water too, and Sharkord's buttons in the sidebars and the chat are glass bubbles that answer the pointer like the bar's buttons (the water rises and leans toward it, the glass lights up, a click sets it jiggling). Sharkord's top bar no longer runs off the right edge. Buttons that plugins add next to Sharkord's own, like Jollyvideo's, now look the same in the Water and Jollyboat themes.

The Water theme is real water and glass now: refracting, frosted glass panels and bubble buttons over live water with caustics, ripples and drifting air bubbles, a glass boat on liquid waves. The Sharkord page floats its parts as glass on the same water, which shows through them: the channel you are on fills with water as you pick it, a sent message drops into the water and whoever talks sends rings across it. The dark water is deeper, small print reads better, and the page and the bar run at 60 frames a second while the window is in front, 30 behind. Without hardware graphics, the theme keeps its lighter CSS water.

The tray icon follows the theme: a glass tile of water for Water, the pixel boat in the dark lcd colours for Jollyboat, and in Sharkord's own dark greys (green while you talk, red when muted) for Sharkord.

A new Water theme: white and blue water under glass, light and dark, for the Sharkord page and for the app's own windows (live water with ripples, air bubbles and the boat riding the waves). The light and dark setting now reaches the setup window too.

The Jollyboat theme is easier to read: online, idle and offline look different at a glance, offline members fade back, text and lines have more contrast, and hover, keyboard focus and menus are clearer.
The bar above a server zooms along with the page.

ul.li: The Jollyboat theme goes further: pixel type, pill buttons, ink outlines, square avatars, a few stepped animations
Settings: a theme choice, Sharkord, Jollyboat or custom, and a light / dark / auto mode
The voice overlay lets clicks through; place it once with "set position"
The overlay's slider is now its transparency
Updated dependencies, performance and security pass
Pop out a stream: a share or camera in its own always-on-top window
Overlay: mute and deafen buttons, optional click-through
Custom CSS for the server page, with an lcd theme to start from
Welcome panel on first run
German and Polish

description.p: Release files follow one naming scheme.

ul.li: Push-to-talk through the desktop's global shortcuts
Optional voice overlay: who is in the call and who talks, on top of other windows
Built from source, with the app ID net.innovativefluid.Jollyboat
Starting with the system goes through the desktop's background permission
Webcams work inside the sandbox through the camera portal

description.p: Experimental macOS build, Windows on ARM, security and privacy pass.
